message:
(Delurking here)
This is an ambitious way of imagining the first day of a writing class, and I like it a lot (in fact, I'd like to try something like it some day). I have one question, though, about the students: I don't have a clear sense of your institution's student body, and I'm wondering about their writing abilities, their overall English abilities, and their previous experiences with English writing. Would they be able to accomplish in 55 minutes what you've set out here? (Perhaps this is beside the point, of course, since your main point seems to be to contrast your perspective from Glenn and Goldthwaite's focus on administrivia...)
